newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs end strongly higher, upbeat on CVRD.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs end strongly higher, upbeat on CVRD.

text.p: Brazilian stocks surged early and stayed up on hefty volume, closing up 2.25 percent on optimism regarding the sale of a controlling stake in Cia Vale do Rio Doce, brokers said.
"The market was good today, a lot of volume," one local trader told Reuters. "Basically, it was due to expectations on the CVRD auction."
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index of 49 most-traded shares surged to close at 10,219 points on soaring volume of 922.9 million reais ($867.4 million).

The bolsa shot up early in the day, aided by rises on Wall Street, as many investors expected the auction to take place Tuesday despite repeated delays due to a string of legal challenges, brokers said.
The day's rise was led by CVRD, whose preferred closed up 4.32 percent at 27.80 reais, some 40 minutes before CVRD's auction, suspended in mid-bid earlier in the day, restarted and quickly ended.
The tender was won by a group led by local steelmaker CSN, which offered 3.3 billion reais, 20 percent above the base price, for a 41.7 percent stake in the mining mammoth.
